notes: OTA self-update now fully completes end-to-end (swap AND relaunch). Root cause of 'update runs but the app stays old': after the file swap, launching the just-written 26 MB exe immediately stalls its loader because Windows Defender scans a freshly-written exe on first run - launching mid-scan left the process alive but its server never bound. Fix: after the swap, force the AV scan to finish first (read the whole file), settle, then relaunch (with a second attempt as backup). Verified: the file swaps to the new version AND the app reopens on it.
